facts.text: Wildwood incorporated on September 1, 1995, yet its roots stretch back to early settlements that shaped the area for generations.
Historic Route 66, now called Manchester Road, cuts straight through Wildwood’s downtown, linking the town to the legendary highway.
The Wildwood Historical Society offers a detailed POI map that highlights the town’s historic communities and landmarks.
During Mother’s Day, Wildwood invites drivers to solve clues at 15 historic Route 66 stops for a chance to win a commemorative T‑shirt.
Fiber broadband is expanding in Wildwood, with AT&T and Socket Telecom installing infrastructure in select subdivisions.
Wildwood sits in the far western portion of Missouri’s largest county, bordered by Chesterfield to the north and Franklin County to the west.
